skills.skill: Murmur in adults with valve disease
skills.result: AUC 0.69 (prolapse, benign murmurs) to 1.00 (aortic stenosis / mitral regurgitation)

skills.evidence: 12 men at rest vs research-grade ECG (367 30-s windows)
skills.result: bias -0.5 bpm, ±10.3 bpm per window; session ICC 0.999

notReady: Adult RMSSD against a research-grade ECG: ICC 0.734, bias 8.8 ms — just misses the rule set beforehand (ICC ≥ 0.75), so it is not shown for adults.

A murmur flag for adults: the flag level was set on children's recordings; on adult sets it flagged 20 % of abnormal recordings in one database (set a) and 100 % of normal ones in another (set f). Each stethoscope needs its own calibration before a flag is used in adults.
Crackles: the rule finds few crackles in adults, and the breath-sound model's crackle AUC on KAUH adults is 0.555.
COPD severity from breath sounds: no relation to GOLD stage in 42 patients (ρ 0.105, p 0.51).
Naming a disease from breath sounds: the adults' model reached AUC 0.679 on held-out patients and failed its gate.
Sleep apnea severity (AHI) from breath sounds: in a 10-patient pilot it found under half of the scored events.
